exposure: predischarge transcutaneous bilirubin (TcB) values at 48-54 hours of age
cohort: Healthy late preterm and term Thai newborn infants (147 hyperbilirubinemia cases and 147 age-matched controls) born between January 2015 and December 2016.
finding: A simple predischarge prediction score, based on gestational age and TcB values at 48-54 hours of life, effectively classified late preterm and term newborn infants into three distinct risk levels for subsequent severe hyperbilirubinemia.
